pages.text: With CC: Tweaked installed, bundled cables connect to computers and turtles: $(item)redstone.setBundledOutput$() drives the cable channels and $(item)redstone.getBundledInput$() reads them.

Peripherals: $(item)redcircuit_gate$() (timer interval, counter, mute) and $(item)redcircuit_wireless$() (frequency, state). Machines, tanks and batteries appear as generic $(item)inventory$(), $(item)fluid_storage$() and $(item)energy_storage$() peripherals.
